
# Queries that return one cell, run by TestScalars in scalars_test.go.
#
# Each case is a query, which may continue on following lines, then "=> " and the JSON of the
# cell's "v" as jobs.query returns it: a string, or null for NULL. Lines starting with # and blank
# lines between cases are ignored.
#
# The default dataset holds a table t (a INT64, b STRING, raw BYTES) with the rows
# (3, 'あ', b'\x00\xff'), (1, 'x', b'a'), (2, 'yy', NULL) and (NULL, NULL, NULL).

## Safe calls

SELECT SAFE.LENGTH('abc')
=> "3"

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_CONTAINS('abc', '(')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_CONTAINS(b, '(') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_CONTAINS(b, 'x') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.CONCAT(SAFE.UPPER(b), SAFE.LOWER('Z')) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "Xz"

SELECT SAFE.DATE_TRUNC(DATE '2024-05-06', MONTH)
=> "2024-05-01"

SELECT SAFE.SUBSTR('abcdef', 2, 3)
=> "bcd"

SELECT SAFE.SUBSTR('abcdef', 2, -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.SUBSTR(b'abc', 2, -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.DIV(1, 0)
=> null

## Operators and conditions

SELECT CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) / 0
=> null

SELECT 1 / CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64)
=> null

SELECT LEFT('abc', CAST(RAND() * 0 AS INT64) + 2)
=> "ab"

## Renamed functions

# DuckDB's uuid() is typed UUID rather than a string, which the cast makes explicit.
SELECT LENGTH(CAST(GENERATE_UUID() AS STRING))
=> "36"

SELECT RAND() >= 0 AND RAND() < 1
=> "true"

SELECT IS_INF(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> "true"

SELECT IS_NAN(CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64))
=> "true"

SELECT ABS(BIGNUMERIC '-1.5') = 1.5
=> "true"

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR('{"a": 1}', '$.a')
=> "1"

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"a": {"b": 1}}', '$.a')
=> "{\"b\":1}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(PARSE_JSON('{"a":1}'))
=> "{\"a\":1}"

## Where DuckDB's function of the same name differs

SELECT CONCAT('a', NULL)
=> null

SELECT CONCAT(b'a', CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null

SELECT CONCAT('a', b, 'c') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "axc"

SELECT GREATEST(1, NULL, 3)
=> null

SELECT LEAST(1, NULL, 3)
=> null

SELECT LEAST(2, 1, 3)
=> "1"

SELECT GREATEST('a', b) FROM t WHERE a = 2
=> "yy"

SELECT IS_NAN(GREATEST(1.0, CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT IS_NAN(LEAST(1.0, CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT LEAST(2, 1.5)
=> "1.5"

SELECT SAFE.MOD(5, 0)
=> null

SELECT MOD(CAST(NULL AS INT64), 0)
=> null

SELECT MOD(-5, 3)
=> "-2"

SELECT MOD(-9223372036854775808, -1)
=> "0"

SELECT MOD(NUMERIC '7.5', 2) = NUMERIC '1.5'
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.MOD(NUMERIC '7.5', 0)
=> null

SELECT DIV(-7, 2)
=> "-3"

SELECT DIV(CAST(NULL AS INT64), 0)
=> null

SELECT REPEAT('ab', 2)
=> "abab"

SELECT REPEAT(b'ab', 2)
=> "YWJhYg=="

SELECT REPEAT('ab', 0)
=> ""

SELECT REPEAT(CAST(NULL AS STRING), -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REPEAT('ab', -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REPEAT('ab', 1000000)
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(SIGN(CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SIGN(-2.5)
=> "-1.0"

SELECT SIGN(-5)
=> "-1"

SELECT SQRT(4)
=> "2.0"

SELECT SAFE.SQRT(-1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.EXP(1000)
=> null

SELECT EXP(CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> "0.0"

SELECT SAFE.LN(0)
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(LN(CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.LOG(8, 1)
=> null

SELECT LOG(8, 2)
=> "3.0"

SELECT SAFE.POW(10, 400)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.POW(0, -1)
=> null

SELECT POWER(2, 10)
=> "1024.0"

SELECT IS_NAN(SIN(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT IS_NAN(ASIN(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.ASIN(2)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.SINH(1000)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ACOSH(0)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ATANH(1)
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(ATANH(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.COT(0)
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(CSC(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SECH(1000)
=> "0.0"

SELECT CBRT(-8)
=> "-2.0"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00.5')
=> "0"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP '1969-12-31 23:59:59.5')
=> "-1"

SELECT UNIX_MILLIS(TIMESTAMP '1969-12-31 23:59:59.9995')
=> "-1"

## Date and time arithmetic

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE '2024-03-01', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
=> "2024-02-29"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL 90
  MINUTE))
=> "2024-01-01 01:30:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_SUB(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL
  1 HOUR))
=> "2023-12-31 23:00:00"

SELECT CAST(TIME_ADD(TIME '10:00:00', INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS STRING)
=> "11:00:00"

SELECT CAST(TIME_SUB(TIME '10:00:00', INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AS STRING)
=> "09:30:00"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME_SUB(DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL 1
  SECOND))
=> "2023-12-31 23:59:59"

## Date part functions

SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', HOUR)
=> "24"

SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:01:00', DATETIME '2024-01-01 00:00:00', SECOND)
=> "60"

SELECT TIME_DIFF(TIME '11:00:00', TIME '10:00:00', MINUTE)
=> "60"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME_TRUNC(DATETIME '2024-05-17 10:20:30', HOUR))
=> "2024-05-17 10:00:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(TIMESTAMP '2024-05-17 10:20:30', DAY))
=> "2024-05-17 00:00:00"

## Formatting and parsing

SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y/%m/%d', DATE '2024-01-02')
=> "2024/01/02"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', PARSE_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S',
  '2024-01-02 03:04:05'))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S',
  '2024-01-02 03:04:05'))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Q|%e|%C|%F', DATE '2024-05-07')
=> "2| 7|20|2024-05-07"

SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%F %H', DATETIME '2024-01-02 03:04:05')
=> "2024-01-02 03"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%E3S|%E*S|%Z', DATETIME '2024-05-17 10:20:30.1234')
=> "30.123|30.1234|%Z"

SELECT FORMAT_TIME('%Y %H:%M:%E6S', TIME '01:02:03.000004')
=> "%Y 01:02:03.000004"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T %Ez', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00', 'Asia/Tokyo')
=> "2024-01-02 12:04:05 +09:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%H:%M', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00', '+05:30')
=> "08:34"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00', NULL)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT_DATE(NULL, DATE '2024-01-02')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00', 'Nowhere/Zone')
=> null

SELECT PARSE_DATE('%A %b %e %Y', 'Thursday Dec 25 2008')
=> "2008-12-25"

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '2024-02-30')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '2024-01-02x')
=> null

SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y', '2024')
=> "2024-01-01"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%F %H:%M:%E6S', PARSE_DATETIME('%F %H:%M:%E*S',
  '2024-01-02 03:04:05.123456789'))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05.123456"

SELECT PARSE_TIME('%I:%M %p', '01:02 PM')
=> "13:02:00"

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_TIME('%H:%M', '25:00')
=> null

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', '2024-01-02 03:04:05', 'Asia/Tokyo'))
=> "2024-01-01 18:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%F %T%Ez', '2024-01-02 03:04:05+09:00',
  'America/New_York'))
=> "2024-01-01 18:04:05"

SELECT PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%F', NULL)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT('%5.2f|%-5s|%05d|%x', 3.14159, 'ab', 42, 255)
=> " 3.14|ab   |00042|ff"

SELECT FORMAT("%'d|%e|%g", 1234567, 1.5, 1.5)
=> "1,234,567|1.500000e+00|1.5"

SELECT FORMAT('%T|%T|%t|%T', 'abc', b'ab', DATE '2024-01-02', DATE '2024-01-02')
=> "\"abc\"|b\"ab\"|2024-01-02|DATE \"2024-01-02\""

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', DATETIME '2024-01-02 03:04:05.5', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00')
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05.500|TIMESTAMP \"2024-01-02 03:04:05+00\""

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T|%T|%t', CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64), CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64), 1.0, true)
=> "nan|CAST(\"-inf\" AS FLOAT64)|1.0|true"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', NULL, NULL)
=> "NULL|NULL"

SELECT FORMAT('%d', NULL)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT(CAST(NULL AS STRING), 1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FORMAT(CONCAT('%', 'd'), 'a')
=> null

## Epoch conversions

SELECT UNIX_MICROS(TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00')
=> "1577836800000000"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(1577836800))
=> "2020-01-01 00:00:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_MICROS(1577836800000000))
=> "2020-01-01 00:00:00"

## String bytes and math functions
# Each case is an edge where DuckDB's counterpart answers differently from BigQuery.

SELECT CHR(0)
=> ""

SELECT CHR(12354)
=> "あ"

SELECT UNICODE('')
=> "0"

SELECT UNICODE('あ')
=> "12354"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(TO_CODE_POINTS('aあ😀\n')) AS x), ',')
=> "97,12354,128512,10"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(TO_CODE_POINTS(b'\x00a\xff')) AS x), ',')
=> "0,97,255"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(TO_CODE_POINTS(''))
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(TO_CODE_POINTS(raw)) FROM t WHERE a = 3
=> "2"

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([97, 12354, 128512])
=> "aあ😀"

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING(TO_CODE_POINTS(b)) FROM t WHERE a = 3
=> "あ"

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([])
=> ""

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([97, NULL])
=> null

SELECT SAFE.CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([97, 55296])
=> null

SELECT SAFE.CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([1114112])
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES([0, 97, 255]))
=> "0061ff"

SELECT TO_HEX(CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES(TO_CODE_POINTS(raw))) FROM t WHERE a = 3
=> "00ff"

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES([97, NULL])
=> null

SELECT SAFE.CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES([256])
=> null

SELECT ASCII('A')
=> "65"

SELECT INSTR('abcb', 'b')
=> "2"

SELECT LEFT('abc', 2) || RIGHT('abc', 1)
=> "abc"

SELECT TRANSLATE('abc', 'ab', 'x')
=> "xc"

SELECT TO_HEX(TRANSLATE(b'\x00ab\xff', b'a\xff', b'\x01'))
=> "000162"

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\x00\xff')
=> "00ff"

SELECT TO_HEX(FROM_HEX('A'))
=> "0a"

SELECT TO_HEX(MD5('a'))
=> "0cc175b9c0f1b6a831c399e269772661"

SELECT BYTE_LENGTH(SHA256('a'))
=> "32"

SELECT TO_BASE64(FROM_BASE64('AP8='))
=> "AP8="

SELECT CAST(IEEE_DIVIDE(1, 0) AS STRING)
=> "inf"

SELECT BIT_COUNT(-1)
=> "64"

SELECT BIT_COUNT(b'\xff\x01')
=> "9"

SELECT BIT_COUNT(b'')
=> "0"

SELECT BIT_COUNT(raw) FROM t WHERE a = 2
=> null

SELECT CAST(CBRT(8) AS INT64)
=> "2"

SELECT CAST(ATAN2(1, 1) * 4 * 1000 AS INT64)
=> "3142"

SELECT SAFE_ADD(9223372036854775807, 1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE_MULTIPLY(a, 2) FROM t WHERE a = 3
=> "6"

SELECT SAFE_NEGATE(1)
=> "-1"

SELECT SAFE_SUBTRACT(1, 2)
=> "-1"

## Substr at big query positions

SELECT SUBSTR('abc', 0, 2)
=> "ab"

SELECT SUBSTR('abc', -5, 2)
=> "ab"

SELECT SUBSTR('abc', -2)
=> "bc"

SELECT SUBSTRING('あいう', 2, 1)
=> "い"

SELECT SUBSTR('abc', 4)
=> ""

## String functions on bytes
# A byte that is not valid UTF-8 must stay whole.

SELECT TO_HEX(LEFT(b'\xffab', 2))
=> "ff61"

SELECT TO_HEX(RIGHT(b'\xffab', 1))
=> "62"

SELECT SAFE.LEFT(b'abc', -1)
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(SUBSTR(b'\xffab', 2))
=> "6162"

SELECT TO_HEX(SUBSTR(b'\xffab', 0, 2))
=> "ff61"

SELECT TO_HEX(SUBSTRING(b'\xffab', -2, 1))
=> "61"

SELECT TO_HEX(REVERSE(b'\x01\xffa'))
=> "61ff01"

SELECT TO_HEX(LOWER(b'\\\xffAz'))
=> "5cff617a"

SELECT TO_HEX(UPPER(b'\\\xffAz'))
=> "5cff415a"

SELECT TO_HEX(LPAD(b'a', 4, b'\xff'))
=> "ffffff61"

SELECT TO_HEX(RPAD(b'a', 2))
=> "6120"

SELECT TO_HEX(LPAD(b'abc', 2))
=> "6162"

SELECT TO_HEX(TRIM(b'\xffa\xffb\xff', b'\xff'))
=> "61ff62"

SELECT TO_HEX(LTRIM(b'aab', b'a'))
=> "62"

SELECT TO_HEX(RTRIM(b'abb', b'ab'))
=> ""

SELECT TO_HEX(REPLACE(b'\x1f\xf1\xff', b'\xff', b'z'))
=> "1ff17a"

SELECT TO_HEX(REPLACE(b'abc', b'', b'z'))
=> "616263"

SELECT INSTR(b'abcb', b'b', 1, 2)
=> "4"

SELECT INSTR(b'abcb', b'b', -1)
=> "4"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(b'', b','))
=> "1"

SELECT TO_HEX(ARRAY_TO_STRING([b'a', NULL, b'\xff'], b'-'))
=> "612dff"

SELECT TO_HEX(ARRAY_TO_STRING([b'a', NULL], b'-', b'\xff'))
=> "612dff"

SELECT STRPOS(b'\x1f\xf1\xff', b'\xff')
=> "3"

SELECT INSTR(b'abc', b'z')
=> "0"

SELECT STARTS_WITH(b'\xffa', b'\xff')
=> "true"

SELECT ENDS_WITH(b'\xffa', b'\xff')
=> "false"

SELECT ASCII(b'\xffa')
=> "255"

SELECT ASCII(b'')
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT TO_HEX(x) FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(b'a\x1f\xf1b', b'\xf1')) AS x), ',')
=> "611f,62"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT TO_HEX(x) FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(b'a\xff', b'')) AS x), ',')
=> "61,ff"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(['a', NULL, 'b'], '-', 'N')
=> "a-N-b"

SELECT TO_HEX(STRING_AGG(raw ORDER BY a)) FROM t
=> "612c00ff"

SELECT TO_HEX(STRING_AGG(raw, b'' ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 1)) FROM t
=> "00ff"

## Google sql functions
# src/backend_functions.cc registers GoogleSQL's implementations of these.

SELECT FARM_FINGERPRINT('')
=> "-7286425919675154353"

SELECT FARM_FINGERPRINT('あ') = FARM_FINGERPRINT(b'\xe3\x81\x82')
=> "true"

SELECT FARM_FINGERPRINT(CAST(NULL AS STRING))
=> null

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FARM_FINGERPRINT(raw)) FROM t
=> "2"

SELECT TO_HEX(SHA512('abc'))
=> "ddaf35a193617abacc417349ae20413112e6fa4e89a97ea20a9eeee64b55d39a2192992a274fc1a836ba3c23a3feebbd454d4423643ce80e2a9ac94fa54ca49f"

SELECT SHA512(b'\xff') = SHA512(FROM_HEX('ff'))
=> "true"

SELECT INITCAP('hello WORLD-everyone!')
=> "Hello World-Everyone!"

## Google sql string functions
# Each case is an edge where DuckDB's counterpart answers differently from BigQuery.

SELECT UPPER('straße')
=> "STRASSE"

SELECT LOWER('ΑΣ')
=> "ας"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(TO_CODE_POINTS(REVERSE('a\u0301b'))) AS x), ',')
=> "98,769,97"

SELECT REVERSE(b) FROM t WHERE a IS NULL
=> null

SELECT TRIM(' \t\u3000a\n')
=> "a"

SELECT LTRIM('\u00a0a ') || RTRIM(' a\u2003')
=> "a  a"

SELECT TRIM('xax', 'x')
=> "a"

SELECT SAFE.TRANSLATE('abca', 'aa', 'xy')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.TRANSLATE(b'abca', b'aa', b'xy')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.TRANSLATE(REPEAT('a', 1048576), 'a', 'é') IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.REPLACE(REPEAT('a', 1048576), 'a', 'aa') IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT ASCII('')
=> "0"

SELECT SAFE.ASCII('é')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.LEFT('abc', -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.RIGHT('abc', -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.LPAD('abc', 5, '')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.RPAD('abc', -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.LPAD('a', 1048577) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT RPAD('あ', 3, 'い')
=> "あいい"

SELECT INSTR('abcb', 'b', 1, 2)
=> "4"

SELECT INSTR('abcb', 'b', -1, 2)
=> "2"

SELECT SAFE.INSTR('abc', 'b', 0)
=> null

SELECT NORMALIZE('\uff21\u2460', NFKC)
=> "A1"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(TO_CODE_POINTS(NORMALIZE('\u00e9', NFD))) AS x), ',')
=> "101,769"

SELECT NORMALIZE_AND_CASEFOLD('Straße', NFKC)
=> "strasse"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR('the blue house', 'Blue')
=> "true"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR('\uff21bc', 'a')
=> "true"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR('abc', '')
=> "true"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR('abc', 'd')
=> "false"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR(b, 'x') FROM t WHERE a IS NULL
=> null

SELECT INITCAP('apples1oranges2pears', '12')
=> "Apples1Oranges2Pears"

SELECT EDIT_DISTANCE('kitten', 'sitting')
=> "3"

SELECT EDIT_DISTANCE('あい', 'いあ')
=> "2"

SELECT EDIT_DISTANCE('kitten', 'sitting', max_distance => 2)
=> "2"

SELECT EDIT_DISTANCE(b'\xe3\x81\x82', b'\xe3\x81\x84')
=> "1"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('ab@cd-ef', '@[^-]*')
=> "3"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('あいう', 'う')
=> "3"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('-2020-jack-class1', '-[^.-]*', 2, 1, 0)
=> "6"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('-2020-jack-class1', '-[^.-]*', 2, 1, 1)
=> "11"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('abc', 'z')
=> "0"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR(b'\xe3\x81\x82b', b'b')
=> "4"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('abc', 'b', NULL)
=> null

## Date time constructors and extract
# Weeks, sub-second parts and differences below a day are where DuckDB's date functions answer
# differently from BigQuery's.

SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-07')
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM DATE '2024-02-01')
=> "32"

SELECT EXTRACT(WEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-07')
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(ISOWEEK FROM DATE '2024-01-07')
=> "1"

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATETIME '2024-05-06 07:08:09')
=> "2024"

SELECT EXTRACT(MILLISECOND FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:12.345678')
=> "345"

SELECT EXTRACT(MICROSECOND FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:12.345678')
=> "345678"

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')
=> "9"

SELECT EXTRACT(DATE FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 20:00:00' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')
=> "2024-01-02"

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(TIME FROM DATETIME '2024-01-01 01:02:03') AS STRING)
=> "01:02:03"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE '2024-01-10', WEEK)
=> "2024-01-07"

SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE '2024-01-10', ISOWEEK)
=> "2024-01-08"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d', DATETIME_TRUNC(DATETIME '2024-01-07 10:00:00', WEEK))
=> "2024-01-07"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-01-07', DATE '2024-01-06', WEEK)
=> "1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-01-08', DATE '2024-01-07', ISOWEEK)
=> "1"

SELECT DATE_DIFF(DATE '2024-01-06', DATE '2024-01-01', WEEK)
=> "0"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP '2001-02-01 01:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2001-02-01 00:00:01', HOUR)
=> "0"

SELECT TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 01:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 23:00:00', DAY)
=> "0"

SELECT TIME_DIFF(TIME '09:59:00', TIME '10:00:30', MINUTE)
=> "-1"

SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2024-01-02 00:00:00', DATETIME '2024-01-01 23:59:59', DAY)
=> "1"

SELECT DATE(2024, 1, 2)
=> "2024-01-02"

SELECT DATE(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 20:00:00', 'Asia/Tokyo')
=> "2024-01-02"

SELECT DATE(DATETIME '2024-01-01 20:00:00')
=> "2024-01-01"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME(2024, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME(DATE '2024-01-02', TIME '03:04:05'))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', DATETIME(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', 'Asia/Tokyo'))
=> "2024-01-01 09:00:00"

SELECT CAST(TIME(1, 2, 3) AS STRING)
=> "01:02:03"

SELECT CAST(TIME(DATETIME '2024-01-01 04:05:06') AS STRING)
=> "04:05:06"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(DATETIME '2024-01-01 09:00:00', 'Asia/Tokyo'))
=> "1704067200"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP(DATE '2024-01-01'))
=> "1704067200"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP('2024-01-01 09:00:00+09'))
=> "1704067200"

SELECT LAST_DAY(DATE '2024-02-10')
=> "2024-02-29"

SELECT LAST_DAY(DATE '2024-02-10', MONTH)
=> "2024-02-29"

SELECT UNIX_DATE(DATE '2020-01-01')
=> "18262"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%d', d) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE
  '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-01-15', INTERVAL 1 WEEK)) AS d), ',')
=> "01,08,15"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2024-01-03'))
=> "3"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%H:%M', t) FROM
  UNNEST(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 01:00:00',
  INTERVAL 20 MINUTE)) AS t), ',')
=> "00:00,00:20,00:40,01:00"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-03', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01',
  INTERVAL -1 DAY))
=> "3"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-03', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01',
  INTERVAL 1 DAY))
=> "0"

SELECT GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01', NULL, INTERVAL 1 DAY) IS NULL
=> "true"

## Buckets

# The examples of the BigQuery reference.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(DATE_BUCKET(d, INTERVAL 2 DAY) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATE
  '1949-12-29', DATE '1949-12-30', DATE '1949-12-31', DATE '1950-01-01', DATE '1950-01-02', DATE
  '1950-01-03']) AS d), ',')
=> "1949-12-28,1949-12-30,1949-12-30,1950-01-01,1950-01-01,1950-01-03"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(DATE_BUCKET(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY, DATE '2000-12-24') AS
  STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-12-20', DATE '2000-12-21', DATE '2000-12-24', DATE '2000-12-25']) AS
  d), ',')
=> "2000-12-17,2000-12-17,2000-12-24,2000-12-24"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_BUCKET(t,
  INTERVAL 7 DAY, TIMESTAMP '2000-12-22 12:00:00')) FROM UNNEST([TIMESTAMP '2000-12-21 13:00:00',
  TIMESTAMP '2000-12-22 12:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2000-12-29 11:59:59']) AS t), ',')
=> "2000-12-15 12:00:00,2000-12-22 12:00:00,2000-12-22 12:00:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', TIMESTAMP_BUCKET(TIMESTAMP '1949-12-31 13:00:00',
  INTERVAL 12 HOUR))
=> "1949-12-31 12:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME_BUCKET(DATETIME '1950-01-01 13:00:00', INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AS STRING)
=> "1950-01-01 12:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME_BUCKET(DATETIME '1950-01-01 13:00:00', INTERVAL '0:30' HOUR TO MINUTE) AS
  STRING)
=> "1950-01-01 13:00:00"

# Months count in the calendar, and last days of the month count as the same day.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(DATE_BUCKET(d, INTERVAL 1 QUARTER, DATE '2000-01-31') AS
  STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2000-04-29', DATE '2000-04-30', DATE '1999-12-31', DATE '1999-10-30']) AS
  d), ',')
=> "2000-01-31,2000-04-30,1999-10-31,1999-07-31"

SELECT CAST(DATE_BUCKET(DATE '2024-05-20', INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AS STRING)
=> "2024-01-01"

## Aggregates and distinct

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> "0"

## Aggregate limit and having modifiers

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(b ORDER BY a LIMIT 2), ',') FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL
=> "x,yy"

SELECT STRING_AGG(b, '|' ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 2) FROM t
=> "あ|yy"

SELECT STRING_AGG(b LIMIT 1) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(b HAVING MAX a), ',') FROM t
=> "あ"

## Approximate and by aggregates

SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(a) FROM t
=> "3"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_QUANTILES(a, 2)) FROM t
=> "[1,2,3]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_QUANTILES(DISTINCT x, 4)) FROM UNNEST([1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) AS x
=> "[1,2,3,4,5]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_QUANTILES(a, 2)) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(x, 2)) FROM UNNEST(['a', NULL, 'b', 'b', NULL, NULL]) AS x
=> "[{\"value\":null,\"count\":3},{\"value\":\"b\",\"count\":2}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(x, 1)) FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 2]) AS x
=> "[{\"value\":2,\"count\":2}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(APPROX_TOP_COUNT(a, 1)) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> null

SELECT MAX_BY(b, a) FROM t
=> "あ"

SELECT MIN_BY(b, a) FROM t
=> "x"

SELECT MAX_BY(x, y) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('a' AS x, 1 AS y), (NULL, 2)])
=> null

SELECT MIN_BY(b, a) OVER () FROM t LIMIT 1
=> "x"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(x ORDER BY ARRAY_LENGTH(x))) FROM (SELECT [1, 2] AS x UNION
  ALL SELECT NULL UNION ALL SELECT [3])
=> "[3,1,2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(x ORDER BY ARRAY_LENGTH(x) DESC LIMIT 1)) FROM (SELECT [1, 2]
  AS x UNION ALL SELECT [3])
=> "[1,2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(x)) FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>) AS x)
=> null

## Value tables

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AS VALUE a FROM t)
=> "4"

## Subqueries

SELECT (SELECT MAX(a) FROM t)
=> "3"

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE a = 2)
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT b FROM t WHERE b IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a DESC), ',')
=> "あ,yy,x"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t WHERE FALSE))
=> "0"

## Unnest structs and arrays

SELECT SUM(x) FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3]) AS x
=> "6"

SELECT s.y FROM (SELECT STRUCT(1 AS x, 'z' AS y) AS s)
=> "z"

SELECT [10, 20, 30][OFFSET(1)]
=> "20"

SELECT [10, 20, 30][ORDINAL(1)]
=> "10"

SELECT [10, 20, 30][SAFE_OFFSET(3)]
=> null

## Operators and array functions

# BigQuery's shifts drop the bits shifted out and fill with zeros, even for negative values.
SELECT 1 << 63
=> "-9223372036854775808"

SELECT 3 << 62
=> "-4611686018427387904"

SELECT -8 >> 1
=> "9223372036854775804"

SELECT 1 << 64
=> "0"

SELECT 8 >> 2
=> "2"

SELECT CAST(NULL AS INT64) << 1
=> null

SELECT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM NULL
=> "true"

SELECT NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL
=> "true"

SELECT 2 IN UNNEST([1, 2])
=> "true"

SELECT 3 IN UNNEST([1, NULL])
=> null

SELECT NULL IN UNNEST([1])
=> null

SELECT 1 IN UNNEST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<INT64>))
=> "false"

SELECT 1 IN UNNEST(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>))
=> "false"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT(['a'], ['b'], ['c']), ',')
=> "a,b,c"

SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT(['a'], CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<STRING>)) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_REVERSE(['a', 'b']), ',')
=> "b,a"

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST([4, 5])
=> "4"

SELECT ARRAY_LAST([4, 5])
=> "5"

SELECT IF(TRUE, 1, ERROR('boom'))
=> "1"

SELECT ROUND(1.25, 1)
=> "1.3"

SELECT ROUND(-2.5)
=> "-3.0"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '2.5', 0, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '2'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '-3.5', 0, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '-4'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '1.25', 1, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '1.2'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '1.251', 1, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '1.3'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '150', -2, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '200'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '12345678901234567890.25', 1, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '12345678901234567890.2'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(BIGNUMERIC '0.5', 0, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = BIGNUMERIC '0'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '2.5', 0, 'ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO') = NUMERIC '3'
=> "true"

SELECT LPAD('a', 3)
=> "  a"

SELECT RPAD('a', 3, 'xy')
=> "axy"

SELECT LPAD('abc', 2)
=> "ab"

## Regular expression functions

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('foo123bar', r'\d+')
=> "123"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('foo123bar', r'o(\d)')
=> "1"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('foo', r'\d')
=> null

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('foo', r'(x)?f')
=> null

SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR('a1b2', r'[(]?\d')
=> "1"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('a1b22', r'\d+'), ',')
=> "1,22"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('a1b2', r'(?:[a-z])(\d)'), ',')
=> "1,2"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('a1b2', r'\d', 1, 2)
=> "2"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('a1b2', r'\d', 3)
=> "2"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT('a1', r'\d', 3)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_EXTRACT('a1', r'\d', 0)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_EXTRACT('ab', r'(a)(b)')
=> null

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(b, b) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(b, NULL) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(REGEXP_EXTRACT(b'\xff1', b'\\d'))
=> "31"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('', '(abc)?'), ',', 'N')
=> ""

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('ab', '(x)?b'))
=> "1"

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL('ab', r'(a)(b)') IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(b'a\xffa', b'a'))
=> "2"

SELECT REGEXP_CONTAINS(b'\xffa', b'a')
=> "true"

SELECT REGEXP_CONTAINS('abc', NULL)
=> null

SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('abc', '', 'x')
=> "xaxbxcx"

SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('abc', 'b*', 'x')
=> "xaxcx"

SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('banana', '(.)a(.)', r'\1\2')
=> "bnana"

SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('a.b', r'\.', r'\\')
=> "a\\b"

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_REPLACE('abc', 'abc', r'\1')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REGEXP_REPLACE('abc', 'b', r'\x')
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(REGEXP_REPLACE(b'a\xffb', b'\xff', b'-'))
=> "612d62"

## Json functions

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT('{x', '$')
=> null

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR('"s"')
=> "s"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(JSON '{"a": true}', '$.a')
=> "true"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_QUERY(JSON '{"a": null}', '$.a'))
=> "null"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY('[]'))
=> "0"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_VALUE_ARRAY('[1, null, "s"]'))
=> "[\"1\",null,\"s\"]"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING_ARRAY(JSON '[true]'), ',')
=> "true"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(JSON '[1]')
=> "array"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(JSON '1.5')
=> "number"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(JSON 'null')
=> "null"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(CAST(NULL AS JSON))
=> null

## Builds and changes json

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(STRUCT(1 AS a, [2, 3] AS b)))
=> "{\"a\":1,\"b\":[2,3]}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(CAST(NULL AS INT64)))
=> "null"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON('s', stringify_wide_numbers => FALSE))
=> "\"s\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT('a', 1, 'b', NULL, 'c', JSON '[1]'))
=> "{\"a\":1,\"b\":null,\"c\":[1]}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT())
=> "{}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT('a', 1, 'a', 2))
=> "{\"a\":1}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT(['a', 'b'], [10, 20]))
=> "{\"a\":10,\"b\":20}"

SELECT JSON_REMOVE(CAST(NULL AS JSON), '$.a')
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_SET(JSON '{}', '$.a', CAST(NULL AS INT64)))
=> "{\"a\":null}"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(JSON_KEYS(JSON '[]'))
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_KEYS(JSON '[{"a": 1}]', mode => 'lax'), ',')
=> "a"

SELECT LAX_BOOL(JSON '"TRUE"')
=> "true"

SELECT LAX_INT64(JSON '"10"')
=> "10"

SELECT LAX_INT64(JSON '1.5')
=> "2"

SELECT LAX_INT64(JSON '[1]')
=> null

SELECT LAX_FLOAT64(JSON '"1.5"')
=> "1.5"

SELECT LAX_STRING(JSON '123')
=> "123"

SELECT LAX_STRING(CAST(NULL AS JSON))
=> null

## Accesses and converts json

SELECT FLOAT64(JSON '1', wide_number_mode => 'round')
=> "1.0"

SELECT BOOL(JSON 'true')
=> "true"

SELECT INT64(CAST(NULL AS JSON))
=> null

## Net functions
# IPv4 addresses are 4 bytes in network byte order; a negative integer is its 32-bit two's
# complement.

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(0xABCDEF))
=> "00abcdef"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(0xFFFFFFFF))
=> "ffffffff"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(-2))
=> "fffffffe"

SELECT TO_HEX(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(-0x80000000))
=> "80000000"

SELECT SAFE.NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(0x100000000)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(-0x80000001)
=> null

SELECT NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(b'\x00\x00\x01\xff')
=> "511"

SELECT NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(b'\xff\xff\xff\xff')
=> "4294967295"

SELECT NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(NET.IPV4_FROM_INT64(-1))
=> "4294967295"

SELECT SAFE.NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(b'\x01\x02\x03')
=> null

SELECT NET.IPV4_TO_INT64(CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null
